correction: The earlier release-review statement requiring a source identity increment for QA was overbroad. A strictly newer version is necessary for the separate requested monotonic-upgrade gate, not intrinsically for normal data-preserving ADB replacement.

android_rule.signer: same signing certificate or valid Android signing lineage
android_rule.version_code: new code may equal installed code
android_rule.revision_codes: For equal versionCode, base and matching split revision codes must not decrease
android_rule.other_compatibility: Actual APK/device compatibility and installer policy checks still apply

unnecessary_for_same_code: source version increment solely to permit ADB replacement
required_before_any_future_install: Actual new APK source/build/hash and expected platform ABI proof
Actual appID ru.boohtacord.app and signer SHA256 match installed QA candidate
Actual versionCode2082 plus nondecreasing base/split revisions
Separate root/user authorization and coordinated phone state; no install in this packet
